problem: Netlify production deploy 6ab414eb5de9a8c4d1c9417f failed during build with exit code 2 while deploy previews passed.
root_cause: Production enables STATIC_I18N_NETWORK=1. Static English generation treated an external Anthropic translation failure as fatal, so a temporary/provider-specific translation error could abort the entire production build even though runtime i18n fallback exists.
prevention: Static translation provider failures must degrade to runtime i18n fallback instead of failing the deployment.
Keep build-time external provider calls non-critical when equivalent runtime fallback exists.
Production release remains fail-closed on exact Netlify SHA and live route proof, but not on optional static translation enrichment.

evidence.netlify_error: Failed during stage 'building site': Build script returned non-zero exit code: 2
evidence.differing_env: STATIC_I18N_NETWORK=1 in production versus 0 in deploy-preview
